note: The interest_rate tag sits in this column's cells and equals n1 on all 1212 plain rows. In the '(incl. #% PIK)' shape, n1 equals the interest_rate tag on all 22 rows and n2 equals the pik_rate tag on all 22, so n1 is the all-in rate and n2 the PIK part. The '#% PIK' shape has a single row, where the number equals the pik_rate tag (and the spread); I treated it as a pure PIK rate. No rate codes appear in this column's shapes.
